اختطفنا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَطَفْنَا (iḵtaṭafnā) /ix.ta.tˤaf.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# اُخْتُطِفْنَا (uḵtuṭifnā) /ux.tu.tˤif.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
